device_entry.description: 一个非物理的软件控制组件，用于连接苏黎世仪器 DAQ/LabOne 服务器及相关实验仪器会话，提供节点树读写、订阅轮询、示波采集、AWG 配置、DIO 调试以及部分开关/电源控制功能，适用于实验自动化与调试。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical software control component for connecting to Zurich Instruments DAQ/LabOne servers and related instrument sessions. It supports node-tree read/write, subscription polling, scope acquisition, AWG configuration, DIO diagnostics, and some switch/power control for lab automation and debugging.
